title: Purified Water system FAT and SAT | Aquemi
meta: Factory and site acceptance tests (FAT, SAT) for your Purified Water package. Under GMP, written so IQ/OQ can reuse them; otherwise, tested against your specification.
headline: Watch it run on water before it ships
lead: Your quality unit approves the protocol; we run the factory acceptance test (FAT) on your Purified Water package. A site acceptance test (SAT) proves the rest on your site.

blocks.h: What FAT proves, what SAT proves
blocks.intro: Under good manufacturing practice (GMP), FAT results executed to your approved protocol can be leveraged at site. Not under GMP: the same wet run proves the limit your process names.
rows: Every sequence, alarm, interlock and divert, restart after power loss included
Critical alarms, interlocks and divert on your utilities and water
Not possible: the skids run on our utilities
Power, drains, air, any heating or cooling; loop hydraulics at peak demand
Full sanitization cycle by a chemical method set per project, residual tested at the end
Full cycle on the installed loop, coldest point of use included
The limit you name: USP, the standard you work to, or your equipment maker's specification
The same limit on your feed water, at the outlet and at any points of use
conclusion: Where shipping and installation cannot change the result, and your quality unit agrees
Feed water, utilities and field piping: proven on site only

blocks.h: Water finds faults a dry check misses

points.t: Some faults show only with water
points.d: A valve opening at the wrong step; out-of-limit water not sent to drain. Found on site, the fix needs a work permit and a production stop.

points.t: Run it, read at the outlet
points.d: Pumps at working pressure; conductivity and total organic carbon measured at the skid outlet.
Approved protocol, calibrated instruments, raw data: results your installation and operational qualification (IQ/OQ) can reuse. A dry checklist is done again in IQ/OQ.

blocks.h: From protocol to release, then SAT
blocks.intro: Not under GMP? The same stages apply, with commissioning and an acceptance test against your specification in place of qualification.

items.d: From the functional specification, sent ahead of FAT, on a date agreed with you. Each test states its acceptance criterion.
Your team may add test cases and confirm which IQ/OQ will reuse. Nothing runs before your quality unit signs.
We run the full protocol first, so the witnessed FAT confirms rather than debugs [confirm].
You witness each test case, in person, remotely or by a delegate you name. Results are recorded as found, never resampled to pass.
Raw data, deviation log and release decision. Skid drained, then dried and sealed by a method named in your proposal.
Critical tests re-run on site; the report feeds IQ/OQ.

items.q: Will our quality unit accept FAT results in place of IQ/OQ tests?
items.a: Yes, if it approves the reuse before the factory acceptance test (FAT). We propose which tests installation and operational qualification (IQ, OQ) can reuse.

items.q: What if a test fails while you are watching?
items.a: It is recorded as found, as a deviation, and never resampled to pass. We investigate, fix and retest that case and any case the fix could affect, with you witnessing. Your quality unit approves how it is closed.

items.q: How long does a FAT take?
items.a: The duration in your schedule for the full Purified Water package, pretreatment to distribution, and a shorter duration for one module. Packages over a size set by transport are tested module by module.

cta.h: Check our criteria against your URS
cta.body: Send your user requirement specification (URS) if you have one. Cost: discussed when you enquire.

cta.turnaround: a time confirmed when you enquire
